title: LTT Dive In: Homepage FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_home_faq_heading
fields.instructions: Required level-two heading displayed above the FAQ list.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_home_faq_description
fields.instructions: A concise introduction to the questions. Keep it to one or two short sentences.

fields.label: Section call to action
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_home_faq_cta
fields.instructions: Optional. Hidden unless both a meaningful label and destination are provided.

fields.label: Frequently asked questions
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_home_faq_items
fields.instructions: Add up to five questions. Each answer opens in place; only one answer is shown at a time.

sub_fields.label: Question
sub_fields.name: question
sub_fields.instructions: Use a short, specific question that makes sense out of context.

sub_fields.label: Answer
sub_fields.name: answer
sub_fields.instructions: Provide a concise answer. Use meaningful link text rather than phrases such as ‘click here’.

sub_fields.label: Answer call to action
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional related destination shown after the answer.

description: Editable content for the reusable global accordion shown above the homepage footer.
